sourceReference: Screenshot of the existing Planet Green phone interface, captured from the local site.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create a premium photorealistic digital brand presentation for Planet Green. Input image is the exact existing Planet Green phone interface and is the mandatory screen-content reference. Preserve its original Planet Green logo, Outfit-like typography, exact readable phrases and green engraved seed illustration. Show one elegant natural human hand with warm medium-brown skin holding one thin black smartphone upright, viewed nearly straight on with slight natural perspective and a subtle 5-degree clockwise tilt. Phone fully visible including top and bottom. Hand supports device from the lower left and behind; thumb along the side without covering important screen content. The wrist enters naturally from the bottom edge. Match a high-end editorial technology product photograph: realistic skin texture, tactile metal and glass, subtle screen reflections, very soft diffused daylight, crisp phone screen, soft skin depth of field. The phone must display the reference UI faithfully: Planet Green logo; 'Your closer life begins here.'; 'The land'; 'The connection'; engraved botanical Seed card; 'Notice. Nourish. Belong.'; 'Field notes'; 'What sustains us deserves our care.'; 'Move to Nature.' No extra devices, added interfaces, labels or text outside the device. Portrait 2:3 composition, phone occupies approximately 65% of canvas height and 55% of width, hand and wrist remain realistic and complete. Isolated hand and smartphone cutout with genuine transparent background, no coloured backdrop, tabletop, scenery, boxes or cast shadow on a background. This should feel like a real hand-held device campaign mockup, not a 3D plastic illustration.
